description:
LLMProvider is a model provider an environment brings its own key for.
metadata.name is its slug. The key is never part of the manifest: apiKey
reads it from an Environment Credential, which stays in the Control Plane.

apiVersion.description:
APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object.
Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and
may reject unrecognized values.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description:
Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents.
Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to.
Cannot be updated.
In CamelCase.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

spec.description: LLMProviderSpec is how to reach a provider and which of its models to offer.

apiKey.description:
APIKey reads the provider's key from an Environment Credential, as
{{ credential("name") }} and nothing else. Without it the provider has
no key.

baseUrl.description: BaseURL overrides the provider's default endpoint.

displayName.description:
DisplayName is the provider's name in the dashboard. It defaults to
metadata.name.

extraHeaders.description:
ExtraHeaders are sent with every request to the provider. A value may
be a credential, such as an X-Api-Key header; the Control Plane exports
every value as ********, which applied back keeps the stored one.

items.description: LLMProviderModel is one model offered from a provider.

contextWindowTokens.description: ContextWindowTokens is the size of the model's context window.

extraHeaders.description:
ExtraHeaders are sent with requests for this model, under the
provider's rule.

label.description: Label is the model's name in the dashboard.

name.description: Name is the model's name at the provider, unique within the provider.

queryParams.description:
QueryParams are added to requests for this model, under the
provider's rule.

type.description: Type of the model, such as chat or embedding.

url.description: URL overrides the provider's endpoint for this model.

provider.description: Provider is the kind of provider, such as openai, anthropic or azure.

queryParams.description:
QueryParams are added to every request to the provider, under the same
rule as ExtraHeaders.

status.description:
ControlPlaneResourceStatus is the Control Plane's view of a resource. The Control Plane
fills it in when it exports a resource, and ignores it when one is applied:
ownership is never taken from a request body.

creationSource.description: CreationSource records how the resource was created: ui, api or gitops.

gitOpsOwner.description:
GitOpsOwner is the GitOps agent that owns the resource. While it is set,
the resource is read-only everywhere else.

agentId.description: AgentID is the authoritative identifier of the owning agent.

agentName.description: AgentName is for display only, and may be stale after a rename.

id.description: ID is the Control Plane's identifier of the resource.

lastModificationSource.description:
LastModificationSource records how the resource was last changed: ui,
api or gitops.
